source: Android could not find an app to open this link.
scope: All 59 scoped catalogue statements for this one new message; default English is additionally bound by the source fixture.
review_type: Independent model-assisted full-statement cross-review. Each draft group was reviewed separately from its authoring. This is not human or native-speaker certification.

methods.mainstream-32: Clause-by-clause agent, negative lookup, missing application, particular link and opening-purpose review, alongside provided current catalogue terminology. This is not a script/placeholder-only check and not blanket fluency certification.
methods.script-regional-synthetic-27: Independently compare each complete authored statement to Android / failed finding / appropriate app / opening purpose / this link. Check scripts and paired meaning, inspect existing catalogue terminology as evidence only, validate exact canonical text and SHA-256. Historical withdrawn audit claims carry no acceptance credit.

provenance_note: Draft hashes identify the reviewed authoring snapshots. This publication contains the exact final reviewed statements; source-binding.json binds them independently to the canonical application resources and immutable expected Git tree.

required_corrections_applied.reason: Result complement 著 is Sixian doˋ, not the different cho̍k reading; author independently verified conversion to PFS tó.

precision_refinements_applied.reason: Makes failed finding explicit rather than potentially implying failure to obtain the app; optional precision improvement accepted by author.

additional_corrections_verified.reason: Retrieved primary dictionary explicitly spells the noun qolbuγasu; corrected second vowel independently verified.

optional_editorial_suggestions_not_appli.text: Системе Android не удалось найти приложение для открытия этой ссылки.
optional_editorial_suggestions_not_appli.reason: Overt dative system noun can remove the foreign-name case ambiguity. Existing text remains semantically intelligible; do not label this an established defect.

source_evidence.supports: Primary Sixian discussion distinguishes result-complement 著 doˋ from other readings; supports required PFS correction.
MOE dictionary examples use 尋毋著 for inability to find; not the entire app sentence.
Sixian source aligns the short result-complement phrase with doˋ. No full lyric is reproduced.

source_evidence.status: primary search-result excerpt; direct fetch failed with 502
source_evidence.supports: Research excerpt identifies result/phase complement do2; retrieval failure is not additional evidence.
MOE dictionary gives literary liân for 連; not the entire new compound or sentence.
Traditional-script noun ᠬᠣᠯᠪᠤᠭᠠᠰᠤ, qolbuγasu; validates the spelling correction, not the whole UI sentence.
Same traditional spelling; this homonym entry does not itself establish the software link sense.
First-party introduction identifies its own web application as aeywankep; supports contemporary app usage, not every newly composed Ainu clause.
First-party Cebuano app help uses app and makakita in computer-search context; it does not attest our whole sentence.
First-party software documentation uses makaabli for the user’s ability to open online channels; lexical/capability evidence, not proof of entire error sentence.
First-party software site uses kini nga link, supporting link as a technical borrowing; no legal content is used as translation authority.

limits: Independent review identified and resolved one concrete reading defect; it is not universal fluency certification.
Five low-idiom-confidence tags remain limited as listed; other per-entry medium-confidence linguistic/script limits are preserved.
Device/runtime resource resolution, no-handler behavior, accessibility and rendering must be established by their own tests.
Cebuano and other per-entry medium-confidence limits remain as stated in the complete individual reviews. No pre-existing catalogue entry gains acceptance credit.

entries.text: Android kon nie ’n toepassing vind om hierdie skakel oop te maak nie.
entries.full_statement_review: Negative modal kon … vind plus clause-final nie correctly brackets the lookup failure. Om hierdie skakel oop te maak specifies the app purpose. Both application and particular link are retained.
entries.reviewer_confidence: high for semantic correspondence of this bounded sentence; not native-speaker certification

entries.text: Android タン URL マカ エアㇱカイ アエイワンケㇷ゚ フナラ ワ ヌカㇻ エアイカㇷ゚.
entries.full_statement_review: Kana was checked against the entire Latin Ainu statement: tan/maka/easkay/aeywankep/hunara/wa/nukar/eaykap align, with protected Android and URL. No Japanese clause was substituted. This script correspondence does not establish that the underlying Ainu idiom is correct; the same unresolved linguistic limit applies.

entries.text: Android tan URL maka easkay aeywankep hunara wa nukar eaykap.
entries.full_statement_review: The explicit Android subject, tan URL object within the open-capability modifier, aeywankep application head and terminal finding-inability clause are structurally consistent with the intended message. The added hunara/search wording is not a connectivity cause. The first-party Aynu.org glossary independently describes its own web application with aeywankep, supporting that app noun. Relative-clause naturalness and the complete idiom remain unconfirmed; historical withdrawn notes do not fill that gap.

entries.text: تعذر على Android العثور على تطبيق لفتح هذا الرابط.
entries.full_statement_review: تعذر على governs Android as the entity unable to act; العثور على تطبيق is finding an application, and لفتح هذا الرابط gives its opening purpose. This does not diagnose a missing browser or failed network.
entries.reviewer_confidence: high for semantic correspondence of this bounded sentence; not native-speaker certification

entries.text: Wala makakita ang Android og app nga makaabli niini nga link.
entries.full_statement_review: Full-clause reading is Wala makakita [did not manage to find], ang Android [actor], og app [indefinite object], nga makaabli [capability relative], niini nga link [this link as opening object]. Borrowed app/link remain technical nouns, while the clause is Cebuano. Niini nga is grammatical; its niining contraction is optional, not a semantic correction. The source terminology and grammar evidence do not certify speaker-preferred idiom; retain medium confidence.
entries.reviewer_confidence: medium; not independent native-speaker attestation

entries.text: Android 尋毋著做得打開這隻連結个程式。
entries.full_statement_review: The full Sixian-oriented clause has failure to find (尋毋著), a capability relative (做得打開這隻連結个) and program head (程式). It does not assert that a browser is missing. The primary MOE dictionary independently uses 尋毋著 in inability-to-find examples. Modern software classifier/compound idiom remains editorial.

entries.text: Android chhìm m̀ tó cho-tet tá-khôi liá chak lièn-kiet ke chhàng-sṳt.

The author independently checked the primary NCU Sixian doˋ account and PFS conversion. Revised full clause aligns with the Han-script Hakka meaning. This resolves that identified reading error but does not attest the entire technical PFS sentence or every compound; idiom confidence remains limited.

entries.text: Az Android nem talált alkalmazást ennek a hivatkozásnak a megnyitásához.

entries.text: Android tidak dapat menemukan aplikasi untuk membuka tautan ini.

entries.reviewer_confidence: high for semantic correspondence of this bounded sentence; not native-speaker certification

entries.text: Android non ha trovato un’app per aprire questo link.

entries.text: Android でこのリンクを開くアプリが見つかりませんでした。
entries.full_statement_review: このリンクを開く is an attributive clause modifying アプリ, so the missing item is an app for this link. 見つかりませんでした gives a polite completed failure. Android で names the platform rather than inventing a connection failure.
entries.reviewer_confidence: high for semantic correspondence of this bounded sentence; not native-speaker certification

entries.text: Android가 이 링크를 열 앱을 찾지 못허엿수다.

The Jeju predicate matches existing grammar-oriented catalogue choices; app/link remain recognizable technical loans. No standard-Korean browser/network advice was introduced. Full native Jeju idiom is not certified.

entries.text: Android에서 이 련결을 열 수 있는 응용프로그람을 찾지 못했습니다.
entries.full_statement_review: North Korean-style 응용프로그람 and initial-r 련결 are maintained; 열 수 있는 modifies the application and 찾지 못했습니다 reports failed finding. Scope remains this link. The link term’s modern DPRK software norm is not independently established.

entries.text: Android에서 이 링크를 열 수 있는 앱을 찾지 못했습니다.
entries.full_statement_review: Android context, this link, can-open app and failed finding are all explicit. The Korean sentence is natural and does not turn the handler failure into a network error or installation instruction.

entries.text: Android에서 이 링크를 열 수 있는 앱을 찾지 못했습니다.
entries.full_statement_review: Same sound Korean sentence; it contains native verbs and technical loans, so a sentence without Hanja does not violate the catalogue’s mixed-script convention. Adding Hanja merely to increase visual density would be unjustified.

entries.text: Android nerado programos šiai nuorodai atverti.
entries.full_statement_review: Negative nerado takes programos, and šiai nuorodai atverti gives the app’s purpose using the demonstrative dative and infinitive. A program/app for this link is clearly the missing item.
entries.reviewer_confidence: high for semantic correspondence of this bounded sentence; not native-speaker certification

entries.text: Android nevarēja atrast lietotni šīs saites atvēršanai.
entries.full_statement_review: Nevarēja atrast is past inability to find. Lietotni is the application object; šīs saites atvēršanai is the opening-purpose dative construction. No omitted or added condition.
entries.reviewer_confidence: high for semantic correspondence of this bounded sentence; not native-speaker certification

entries.text: Android 未尋得可啟此連結之程式。
entries.full_statement_review: Accepted precision refinement 未得→未尋得 makes failed finding explicit instead of leaving obtaining/getting as an alternate reading. 可啟此連結之程式 is a valid concise literary-style relative with recognizable modern technical nouns. No network or browser cause is introduced.

entries.text: Android энэ холбоосыг нээх апп олсонгүй.
entries.full_statement_review: This link is accusative inside the app’s opening-purpose modifier; олсонгүй reports no successful finding. The statement preserves the specific failed app discovery without requiring a browser. It remains a bounded semantic review rather than regional speaker certification.

entries.text: Android ᠡᠨᠡ ᠬᠣᠯᠪᠤᠭᠠᠰᠤ ᠶᠢ ᠨᠡᠭᠡᠭᠡᠬᠦ ᠠᠫᠫ ᠣᠯᠤᠭᠰᠠᠨ ᠦᠭᠡᠢ᠃
entries.full_statement_review: Entire written Mongolian sequence was compared to intended this-link / open / app / did-not-find structure and the Cyrillic semantic counterpart. It uses traditional-script spelling and an explicit object particle rather than embedding Cyrillic wording. I independently retrieved Mongoltoli’s entry spelling qolbuγasu (ᠬᠣᠯᠪᠤᠭᠠᠰᠤ), confirming the author’s correction of the second vowel from ᠣ to ᠤ. Its digital-link use and the full written-register idiom remain editorial.

entries.text: Android ᡝᡵᡝ URL ᠪᡝ ᠨᡝᡳᠮᡝ ᠮᡠᡨᡝᡵᡝ ᠠᡤᡡᡵᠠ ᠪᡝ ᠪᠠᡥᠠᡥᠠᡴᡡ.
entries.full_statement_review: The romanized whole statement has this URL as the opening object, neime mutere as app capability, agūra as the searched object and bahahakū as negative completed finding. Existing agūra is a tool/application extension, not an attested modern Manchu standard. I cannot independently certify complete idiom or lexical extension from available primary evidence; unchanged confidence is warranted.

entries.text: Android tidak dapat menemui aplikasi untuk membuka pautan ini.

entries.text: Android 揣無會當開這个連結的程式。

Native Taiwanese function words distinguish the sentence from Mandarin. Technical linked-compound naturalness remains editorial, not external whole-sentence attestation.

MOE independently supports liân for literary 連, but that does not certify the newly composed digital compound or whole UI sentence.

Android is an undeclined foreign platform name in the experiencer position. The meaning is clear, although adding Системе before Android would make its dative role overt; this is an optional editorial clarification, not an established semantic defect.

entries.text: Android 空 尋 𧡊 應用 抵 𢲫 連結 尼.

The app and this-link objects are not swapped, and syntax is Vietnamese rather than Chinese. Exact historic spelling and modern technical orthographic acceptance remain separate from this bounded reading check.
